input: 画出月度销售额趋势图
expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', 下单时间) AS 月份, SUM(金额) AS 销售额 FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成' GROUP BY 月份 ORDER BY 月份

input: 用饼图展示各品类占比
expected_sql: SELECT 品类, SUM(金额) AS 销售额 FROM orders JOIN products ON orders.product_id = products.id GROUP BY 品类
notes: 用户指定饼图，品类少适合饼图

input: 各城市的销售分布对比图
expected_sql: SELECT users.城市, SUM(orders.金额) AS 销售额 FROM orders JOIN users ON orders.user_id = users.id GROUP BY users.城市 ORDER BY 销售额 DESC
notes: 城市数量多，柱状图更合适

input: 可视化一下用户的年龄段分布
expected_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN 年龄 < 25 THEN '18-24' WHEN 年龄 < 35 THEN '25-34' ELSE '35+' END AS 年龄段, COUNT(*) AS 人数 FROM users GROUP BY 年龄段
notes: 年龄段分组少，饼图合适

input: 每周订单量变化趋势图
expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%W', 下单时间) AS 周, COUNT(*) AS 订单数 FROM orders GROUP BY 周 ORDER BY 周
